supplements.finding_text: L924-L929: DETTMP is first assigned the reciprocal determinant and then compared with 0.0. A singular denominator raises division-by-zero/Inf rather than making its reciprocal exactly zero, so the STOPP singular-transform guard is ineffective.
supplements.authoritative_quote:
DETTMP = 1./( CUE(L)*CVN(L) - CUN(L)*CVE(L) )
      if( DETTMP == 0.0 )then
        write(6,6262)
        write(6,6263) IL(L), JL(L)
        call STOPP('.', 1)
supplements.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)
supplements.rationale: DETTMP=1/det then compared ==0.0: reciprocal of singular det is Inf not 0, so STOPP guard is dead code

supplements.finding_text: AGE is declared INTENT(OUT) at L110, but its incoming values are read in the initiation/aging test at L141-L146 and as neighbor history at L175-L214, before every element is necessarily defined by this invocation. The algorithm requires persistent prior age, so the declared interface conflicts with its use and should be assessed as INOUT.
supplements.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-27: AGE declared DIMENSION(M,N),INTENT(OUT) (L112) but read as prior/persistent history at L152,L155 and neighbor L183=AGE1=AGE(I-1,J) before any write in this invocation. INTENT(OUT) makes actual arg undefined on entry; breaker age-tracking requires persistence → should be INOUT. base missed. (manifestation compiler-dependent: many compilers leave INTENT(OUT) arrays intact, but it is UB.)
supplements.reconfirm_method: span re-extracted from live source at cited lines; source_file_sha256 vs record source_sha256 checked by verifier

supplements.finding_text: Use-before-assignment across branches: breaking_kernel assigns DXg and DYg only inside the Age_sh<=ZERO, non-immediate-trigger branch at L168-L184, but all paths then use them to compute xmk/ymk at L234-L238. If the immediate trigger branch L162-L164 or positive-age branch L166-L167 is taken, wavemaker footprint selection consumes undefined DXg/DYg.
supplements.authoritative_quote:
REAL(SP) :: xmk,ymk,DXg,DYg
…
                DXg=DX_d
                DYg=DY_d
…
        xmk=(I-Ibeg)*DXg + (iista-1)*DXg
        ymk=(J-Jbeg)*DYg + (jjsta-1)*DYg
# else
        xmk=(I-Ibeg)*DXg
supplements.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-27: breaking_kernel DXg/DYg(decl L137) assigned only in innermost Age_sh<=ZERO branch (L173-174/179-180); breaking(AGE=DT) and aging(Age_sh>ZERO) branches leave unset, yet xmk/ymk use them after all ENDIFs at L234-237. Directly (no Gamma multiplier) → real UBA. GPU variant of breaker.f90/breaker.F confirmed delta. base missed.

supplements.finding_text: Out-of-bounds search: lines 251-254 increment Kstart while TIME(Kstart)<time_cut without checking Kstart<=Ndata (or Ntotal). If time_cut exceeds the final available timestamp, TIME is indexed beyond valid data and potentially beyond its allocation before the loop can terminate.
supplements.rationale: span-verified 2026-08-27: unbounded DO WHILE search over TIME() with no Kstart<=Ndata/Ntotal bound; time_cut past last timestamp reads uninitialized elements and past Ntotal=10000 exceeds allocation (OOB). base missed.

supplements.finding_text: Lines 379-380 compare abs(omega) against VorticityMax but then store signed omega rather than abs(omega). A new negative extremum can make VorticityMax negative, after which later positive magnitudes trivially exceed it; the stored field therefore does not consistently represent a maximum magnitude.
supplements.rationale: VorticityMax: abs(omega) 비교 후 signed omega(I,J) 저장(L379-380) → 음의 극값이 VorticityMax 를 음수화, 최대 크기장 부정확. 진단출력 결함. base 미검출.
supplements.reconfirm_method: span re-extracted from live source at cited lines; source_file_sha256 vs record source_sha256 checked by verifier

supplements.finding_text: Station buffering loses and/or fabricates samples: once the condition at L2428 is false, the current sample is never inserted before L2435-L2438 flush and reset, so each overflow-triggering sample is dropped. At TIME>=TOTAL_TIME the same ELSE writes exactly StationOutputBuffer rows even when BufferCount is smaller; ZUV_Buffer was allocated at L2374-L2375 but not initialized, so unwritten tail rows can be uninitialized on the first partial flush or stale after later flushes before files close at L2451-L2457.
supplements.authoritative_quote:
IF(BufferCount(i)<StationOutputBuffer.AND.TIME<TOTAL_TIME)THEN
              BufferCount(i) = BufferCount(i) +1
              ZUV_BUFFER(BufferCount(i),i,1)=time
              ZUV_BUFFER(BufferCount(i),i,2)=eta_sta
              ZUV_BUFFER(BufferCount(i),i,3)=u_sta
              ZUV_BUFFER(BufferCount(i),i,4)=v_sta
            ELSE
              DO j=1,StationOutputBuffer
                write (iunit,'(E21.10E4, 3E16.5E4)') (ZUV_BUFFER(j,i,k),k=1,4)
              ENDDO              
              BufferCount(i) = 0
supplements.rationale: station 버퍼: BufferCount==StationOutputBuffer(full) 시 ELSE(L2434) 가 flush+reset(L2438)만 하고 현 샘플 미삽입 → overflow 유발 샘플 드롭. TIME>=TOTAL_TIME 시 BufferCount 미만이어도 StationOutputBuffer 행 전체 기록=낡은행 조작. base 미검출.
supplements.reconfirm_method: span re-extracted from live source at cited lines; source_file_sha256 vs record source_sha256 checked by verifier

supplements.finding_text: EtaBlowVal is declared without initialization at L384. In io.f90 its READ_FLOAT is commented and an unrelated stale ierr condition controls a 10.0 assignment; CHECK_BLOWUP later always compares against EtaBlowVal. Unless another initialization routine always assigns it, the stability check can use undefined data.
supplements.rationale: EtaBlowVal 무초기화 선언(mod_global L384). io.f90 L2104 READ_FLOAT 주석처리, L2105 IF(ierr==1) 의 ierr 는 직전 OUT_Radiation read(L2101) 것 → 해당 키 존재 시 EtaBlowVal 영구 미대입, CHECK_BLOWUP 가 미정의 임계값 사용. base 미검출.

supplements.finding_text: Several error paths say STOP or diagnose invalid input but call MPI_FINALIZE without STOP, RETURN, or control transfer: zero depth/period at lines 102-105 and infeasible periodic-angle searches at lines 117-128 and 137-147 continue into later wavemaker logic after MPI has been finalized; CalcPeriodicTheta likewise finalizes at line 912 and continues at line 915. The initial period guard is additionally too late because 2*pi/Tperiod is already evaluated at line 98.
supplements.authoritative_quote:
IF(DEP_WK==ZERO.OR.Tperiod==ZERO)THEN
         if(myid.eq.0) write(*,*) 're-set depth, Tperiod for wavemaker, STOP!'
         call MPI_FINALIZE ( ier )
supplements.rationale: 에러경로가 MPI_FINALIZE 호출 후 STOP/RETURN 없이 낙하(L102-104 zero depth/period; 유사 L122-129 periodic-angle). MPI 종료 후 실행 지속=UB. base 미검출.
